name: What can go wrong with built-in shelving installation?
description: Common problems are bad fit, weak mounting, uneven shelves, and finish details that do not match the room.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with built-in shelving installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are poor anchoring, uneven shelves, gaps at the trim, and a design that looks custom on paper but doesn’t fit the room well. Moisture, warped walls, or hidden electrical and plumbing can also complicate installation. Choosing a builder who checks the space carefully before fabrication helps avoid expensive rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems are bad fit, weak mounting, uneven shelves, and finish details that do not match the room.
